text: Without granular attribution a meaningful citation graph cannot be constructed, because the system cannot record which dimension of a contribution was valuable, for example strong conceptual innovation paired with poor execution.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998

isBasedOn.name: Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution

abstract: Without granular attribution, we cannot build a meaningful citation graph. We don't know that Alice's innovation insight was valuable even though her execution was poor, or that Bob's contribution was primarily in implementation rather than conceptual novelty.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: validation collapses multidimensional assessment into a single bit
